instruction: Triage in/batches.csv (header lot,item,qty,expires; expires is YYYY-MM-DD) against the date in in/today.txt. Ignore rows with qty 0. A lot is expired if expires is before today, use_soon if expires is today or at most 7 days after today, otherwise ok. Write out/triage.json: {"expired": [lots in file order], "use_soon": [lots in file order], "ok_qty": {item: summed qty of ok lots}}.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
